subject: Urgent: Exec signoff needed for renewal concessions — Orbital Analytics
messages:
From: Samantha Reed <samantha.reed@orbitalanalytics.com>
To: markus.klein@redwood.ai
Cc: Tom Liu <tom.liu@orbitalanalytics.com>, procurement@orbitalanalytics.com
Date: 2026-08-01T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal proposal questions and reliability concerns

Markus,

Thanks for sending the renewal package last week. Tom and I reviewed the numbers and the proposed increase compared to our current commit is a blocker for us. Separately, we experienced a 45-minute incident in June that impacted our ingestion pipeline; that downtime cost us ~2 engineering days to remediate and re-run jobs.

Before we proceed to procurement, we need to understand what concessions you can offer — specifically: a one-time credit to offset remediation costs, a 12-month term reset so pricing scales from today's usage, and a documented SLA addendum that covers credits for future incidents. If you can scope those, we can turn this around quickly.

Samantha
Head of Data Products
Orbital Analytics

——
Note: attaching the incident timeline internally — happy to share more if helpful.

From: markus.klein@redwood.ai <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Reed <samantha.reed@orbitalanalytics.com>
Date: 2026-08-01T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal proposal questions and reliability concerns

Samantha — thanks for the clear ask and context. I’m really sorry about the June incident; I know that kind of disruption is costly and frustrating. I can work to get you: (1) a one-time credit, (2) a term reset for 12 months pricing baseline, and (3) an SLA addendum drafted.

I need exec signoff for the specific USD credit amount and to approve the SLA language (we have a standard addendum to start from). I’m looping in Lauren and Monica internally to size the concession and route for approval. Will follow up with numbers by EOD.

Best,
Markus
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0132

Attachment: redwood_proposal_v3.pdf

From: markus.klein@redwood.ai <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-04T08:26:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Renewal proposal questions and reliability concerns — need exec approval for concessions

Team — forwarding the customer note (below). Quick summary and recommended ask: Orbital Analytics (MID-MKT, $420k ARR) requests a one-time credit to offset the June incident, a 12-month term reset to today’s usage for pricing, and an SLA addendum guaranteeing availability + credits. They’re contractually up for renewal 9/15; procurement wants final paper by 8/25. If we don’t move, risk is churn or them switching to another provider after procurement delay.

Proposed concession (conservative):
- One-time credit: 20% of current renewal value (approx $84k) applied to first invoice after renewal.
- Term reset: 12 months starting at renewal effective date, with current committed units as baseline.
- SLA addendum: 99.9% monthly target with 10x service credit ladder (standard draft attached).

Rationale: preserves ARR, avoids churn, and aligns with CS escalation (Monica). I’ve attached the updated proposal (redwood_proposal_v3.pdf) and a draft SLA addendum (sla-amendment-draft.docx). Please advise approval or changes; if you want a lower credit we can propose a 15% credit + step-down true-up instead.

Request: Exec signoff (Vivek) for the one-time credit and authority to commit SLA language. Also please confirm whether legal should redline the SLA before we send.

Thanks,
Markus

---------- Forwarded message ----------
(Original customer email above)

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: markus.klein@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-04T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Fwd: Renewal proposal questions and reliability concerns — need exec approval for concessions

Markus — thanks for the crisp summary. From a renewals ops perspective I agree a concession is preferable to losing the account. A few notes:
- Orbital has been steady for 24 months and recently expanded ingestion usage; short-term uplift from the outage is material.
- If we approve 20% credit that sets an internal precedence; recommend we cap at 15% unless Vivek approves otherwise.
- SLA addendum: legal will want to limit credit exposure — our standard ladder in the attached draft is ok but propose adding a "performance remediation" clause (CS-led) before automatic credits above 2 incidents/year.

Can we present a counter: 15% one-time credit ($63k), 12-month term reset, and a slightly revised SLA that includes remediation steps and a max annual credit cap of 30% of ARR? If customer pushes, escalate back to you Vivek for exception to 20%.

Happy to prep the one-pager for exec signoff.

—Lauren
Head of Sales Operations

From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, markus.klein@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-05T13:45:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Fwd: Renewal proposal questions and reliability concerns — need exec approval for concessions

Team — I appreciate the framing. Approve the following (final):
- One-time credit: 15% of renewal value (approve $63,000).
- Term reset: 12 months as requested.
- SLA addendum: approve standard ladder with added remediation clause; legal to limit aggregated annual credits to 30% ARR.

Conditions:
1) Credit is one-time, non-recurring and applied to the first invoice post-renewal.
2) Monica to lead customer remediation plan and close the open reliability action items before final signature.
3) If Orbital requests >15% or upfront pro-rata reduction in committed units, re-escalate to me and Finance.

Markus — please send the counterproposal to Samantha with the approved numbers and attach the SLA draft. Loop legal early but hold on final redlines until customer signals acceptance.

-Vivek
VP, Revenue Operations

From: markus.klein@redwood.ai <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Reed <samantha.reed@orbitalanalytics.com>
Cc: Tom Liu <tom.liu@orbitalanalytics.com>, procurement@orbitalanalytics.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-09T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Proposal update and confirmed concessions for Orbital Analytics renewal

Samantha — thank you again for the patience. Per internal review we can offer the following final concession to move the renewal forward:

1) One-time credit of 15% of renewal value — USD 63,000 — applied to the first invoice after the renewal effective date.
2) 12-month term reset: pricing and committed units will be reset to your current run-rate for 12 months from the renewal effective date.
3) SLA addendum: attached draft (sla-amendment-draft.docx) — includes 99.9% monthly target, a service credit ladder, and a remediation-first clause. Legal will limit aggregated annual credits to 30% of ARR.

Next steps:
- Please confirm by EOD 8/13 if Orbital accepts so procurement can route signatures for a 8/25 paper deadline.
- Monica will follow up with the remediation plan and a short incident report for your records.

If you'd like a quick call to walk the terms, I can coordinate a 30-minute slot tomorrow.

Best,
Markus Klein
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.ai
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0132

Attachments: sla-amendment-draft.docx, cost-impact-note.xlsx
